Updates and known limitations

1 November 2026 — clearer workflows and examples

  • Added a four-page labelled practice report and expected results for page operations.
  • Replaced generic PDF instructions with steps specific to each tool.
  • Corrected outdated image-page text that said PDF tools were still planned.
  • Made guides, practice files and help reachable from the shared navigation, including a mobile menu.
  • Expanded maintenance and correction information.

Current limitations

Office conversion (including PPT to PDF), OCR, secure redaction and existing-text editing are not available. No release date is promised. Image sizing uses manual requirements, not verified exam presets. The optimizer does not recompress scanned images. PDF modifications may omit document-level features or invalidate signatures.

Help improve the tools

Try a known practice task. If its result is wrong, report the tool, your browser, the settings and the error via Contact. Keep personal documents out of reports. Public code changes are available on GitHub.
